newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares end soft, trend seen on for weeks.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares end soft, trend seen on for weeks.

text.p: Zimbabwe's key industrial index dropped over 30 points points on Friday under pressure from small speculative sellers, and amid predictions that the soft trend could continue for weeks in the absence of big corporate players.
"The big guys are on the sidelines trying to make sense of the market and awaiting some company results," one broker commented.
"And many these guys are unlikely to come back for serious play for a greater part of this month," he said.

The main industrial index dropped 30.25 points to close at 10,794.37 following some losses in some heavyweight counters, including hotel and supermarket group Meikles, which traded 30 cents down at 2,800, and banking group Barclays, which lost 50 cents to 3,100.
The secondary seven-share mining index climbed 3.63 points to 1,022.17 after a 10-cent rise in coal mining group Wankie Colliery at 550.
The mining index slipped 3.61 points to 1,018.54.
